title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: _Nonnull annotation violated on ctx field
description:
struct coap_oscore_auth_result declares 'struct oscore_ctx *_Nonnull ctx;' but when the request is unprotected (local admin path), result->ctx = NULL is set. Clang -fnullability will flag this. Callers already guard with if (auth.ctx != NULL), expecting nullable semantics.

Location: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/include/lichen/coap_oscore.h:125 (_Nonnull), coap_oscore.c:301 (NULL assignment).
